title: End-to-end: Thunderbird subscribes, reads articles, posts reply
description:
Drive Thunderbird in headless mode (or use a Thunderbird-compatible Python NNTP client that exercises the same code path) to: connect to reader, subscribe to a group, download headers (OVER), fetch article bodies, post a reply. Verify the reply appears via ARTICLE. Artifact: tests/e2e/thunderbird_compat.py.

Acceptance criteria:
- Group subscription (LIST ACTIVE + GROUP) works
- OVER-based header download populates a message list
- ARTICLE fetch retrieves body
- Posted reply is retrievable as a new article
- Test is headless and runs in CI without a display server
